sections.heading: 1. Move within your cleared range
lines: ① Open and close your hand, 10 times.
② Hand on a table, slide it forwards.
③ Lean forward, let the arm gently swing.
④ Do it little and often through the day.

sections.heading: 2. Stop and get checked if…

caption:
Mr Turtle wore a sling for weeks. Now it's off, but his arm won't lift very far.

A shoulder that's been resting often stiffens up. Moving it gently and often, within the range your treating team has cleared, can help it slowly feel easier.

Hybi's shoulder wake-up: open and close your hand, slide your hand forwards on a table, and lean forward to let the arm gently swing. Little and often through the day works well.

Pain that keeps getting worse, swelling or tingling is worth checking first. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
